title: Reduced Payment Plan Tenure Points by Loan Age
content:
**Rule.** For a Reduced Payment Plan of the Hardship Assistance Programs, a loan funded at least 24 whole calendar months before the request date earns 2 points; a loan funded at least 12 but fewer than 24 whole calendar months before it earns 1 point; a younger loan earns none. Months are counted from the funding date on the borrower's Personal Loans record, a month being completed only when the later date reaches the funding day of the month. Each point is one percentage point off the percentage at which the Reduced Payment Plan installment is set.

| Whole calendar months from funding to the request date | Points |
|---|---|
| 24 or more | 2 |
| 12 to 23 | 1 |
| fewer than 12 | none |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

- Funded 15 May; request on 14 May two years later: 23 whole months, 1 point. Request on 15 May two years later: 24 whole months, 2 points.
- Funded 15 May; request on 14 May the following year: 11 whole months, no points. On 15 May the following year: 12 months, 1 point.
- Funded 31 January; request on 28 February of the following year: February has no 31st and the request date does not reach the funding day, so 12 whole months are complete, 1 point.
